comment: Commit and record MACs (reference mac.ts computeCommitMac / computeRecordMac) with fixed shared secrets, and the Atproto-Space-Want-Mac / Atproto-Space-Mac headers (formatWantMacHeader, formatMacHeader, parseWantMacHeader, parseMacHeader). Commit data and MACs are hex; a null mac is a refusal. A null header value is an absent header.

commitMacs.name: reference test commit
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: HMAC-SHA256(secret, "atproto-space-repo-v1" ‖ len‖space ‖ len‖repo ‖ len‖rev ‖ data).

commitMacs.name: field boundary: repo did:example:alice, rev 3kbc
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: the length prefixes keep these two apart.

commitMacs.name: field boundary: repo did:example:alice3, rev kbc
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: the length prefixes keep these two apart.

commitMacs.name: empty repo
commitMacs.note: SPC-77: data of an empty repo is SHA-256 of the zero state.

commitMacs.name: ver 2 has the MAC of ver 1
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: the reference context is "atproto-space-repo-v1" whatever the commit's ver; ver itself is not MACed (verifyCommit refuses ver ≠ 1 before the MAC).

commitMacs.name: multi-byte UTF-8 fields
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: lengths count UTF-8 bytes, not characters or UTF-16 units (the fields are not valid syntax; the MAC does not validate).

commitMacs.name: a 300-byte space
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: a length prefix above 255 uses both bytes.

commitMacs.name: a 65535-byte rev
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: the longest field a uint16 prefix encodes.

commitMacs.name: a 65536-byte rev
commitMacs.note: SPC-56: a field longer than a uint16 prefix encodes is refused.
commitMacs.referenceError: Error: value does not fit in a uint16: 65536

recordMacs.name: a raw-codec CID
recordMacs.note: SPC-56: the MAC covers the CID bytes as given.

recordMacs.name: a 300-byte uri
recordMacs.note: SPC-56: a length prefix above 255 uses both bytes.

parsing.note: SPC-55/56: members other than type, ver and key_share are ignored.

parsing.note: SPC-55/56: RFC 8941 keeps the last of a repeated key.
